dedupe_keys.name: areas de acceso peatonal de las manzanas del cuidado

description: Áreas de acceso peatonal de las manzanas del cuidado is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de la Mujer - SDMujer. La delimitación y localización de manzanas del cuidado obedece a los siguientes criterios: - Garantizar proximidad, caminabilidad y accesibilidad y asequibilidad considerando las condiciones físicas de las personas sujetas de cuidado y de las cuidadoras, y la forma en que se desplazan, empleando aproximadamente 15 minutos caminando o en medios de micromovilidad. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de la Mujer - SDMujer. Its tags are acceso, area, cuidado, manzana, mujer. It offers 21 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
